title: Chapter 900
text:
"Wow, what a huge lump!"

"This one is quite interesting. It has a deja vu of Ultraman's transformation device."

"He looks like a Resident Evil transformation device no matter how I look at it!"

"He really does look like a Crawler …"

"What Crawler? This is a Tyrant!"

"Bullsh * t, look at that sexy bone spike. It's obviously an Abomination!"

"Don't try to fool me. This is clearly a Balala Little Monster transformation."

The other players regained their senses, and their eyes lit up as they surrounded the Abomination.

Their height only reached up to the Abomination's crotch, and they poked the Abomination's body like dwarves surrounding a giant.

"Hey! Don't touch my butt with your little hands! If you're so curious, why don't you transform yourselves? "

Flustered and exasperated, the player swung his palm out like a sledgehammer, sending the surrounding players flying and crashing into the metal wall with a loud bang, leaving a shallow dent in the wall.

The few players who were sent flying were not angry. They quickly got up, patted their arms and knees, and spat out a mouthful of blood. They then happily surrounded the Abomination again.

"That hit just now gave me a crushing damage. That's fierce."

"Quick, put up the attribute panel."

The others surrounded the Abomination and made a ruckus.

Han Xiao observed from the side, and his eyes lit up.

The Ovitan Badge was a device that had been modified many times. The Evolutionary Civilization would not create soldiers without intelligence. The Abomination would retain a certain level of consciousness and would not enter the [Chaos] state. However, their intelligence and mental resistance would plummet, and they would only be able to make simple judgments. However, due to the uniqueness of the players, after using the Ovitan Badge, their consciousness would not change.

This proved that the players were the perfect candidates to use the Ovitan Badge.

With complete intelligence, they would be able to unleash the full power of the ultimate evolution!

Han Xiao coughed and interrupted the conversation. He walked over and asked, "How do you feel now? Can you still control your body?"

"Yes." The Abomination made a few movements out of curiosity, showing an astonishing agility. He then used his nails to scratch his bald head.

Han Xiao nodded. With a flick of his finger, nanoparticles slid out from his sleeves and turned into metal needles.

"Don't move, let me check your body."

As he spoke, Han Xiao pierced the needle into the Aberration's body and triggered the damage. A combat notification popped up on the interface.

Glancing at it, the effects of the Ovitan Badge appeared in the player's status bar in the form of a BUFF.

[Extreme Evolution — Aberration]: Your genes have been modified by the [Ovitan Badge], and your Class has temporarily changed to [High Level Creature Aberration]. Your base END bonus has been changed to 1: 200, + 30% STR, DEX, and END, -50% INT, MYS, and CHA. Bonus stats: + 240 STR, + 200 DEX, + 200 END, -300 INT, -300 MYS, -500 CHA.

Your total Physical Resistance bonus has been increased by 1.3x, and your total Mental Resistance bonus has been increased by 0.4x. Your HP and Stamina recovery rate has been increased by 200%. You will lose 300-600 HP every minute, and your HP recovery rate will be decreased by 30-60% every half hour. Maximum HP will be decreased by 10,000-20,000 every hour.

[Efficiency of using any non-melee equipment in this state -90% (including but not limited to mechanical devices, magic items, firearms, etc.). Some incompatible skills and abilities will be temporarily frozen (unusable). + 100% cost of using skills. Your melee attacks will have [Cleave] and [Horizontal Sweep] effects. + 70% melee attack power. + 25% base success rate of [Strength Suppression] and [Strength Crush].]

Remarks: Dance to your heart's content before death catches up with you!

Wow, these effects are amazing!

Han Xiao perked up and quickly analyzed the situation.

The Aberration was clearly a melee type. The Evolutionary Civilization had set the Ovitan Badge as a genetic evolution direction, which was mainly to strengthen the body. It was weaker in terms of magic and mental strength.

After all, the original intention of designing the Ovitan Badge was to deceive investors … cough cough, it was to make everyone a soldier. Thus, strengthening the body was the best way for ordinary people to quickly become strong.

After the transformation, the biggest advantage would be the tankiness!

In Version 3.0, the player's level limit was 120. Han Xiao recalled that when he was at level 120, his HP was close to 30,000. The players did not have the Molding Talent Life Strengthening, so their HP was around 10,000. The base END bonus was 1: 50, and this transformation would increase the END bonus by four times!

Just the additional END bonus alone would increase the player's HP by 40,000. Coupled with the hundreds of END points that the level 120 players already had, their HP could exceed 100,000. In terms of HP alone, it was comparable to the HP of a normal Calamity Grade!

Ordinary Level 120 players would only have a few hundred Attribute Points if they didn't break the 1,000 mark. Their Strength, Agility, and Endurance Attributes would be doubled.

The benefits of the transformation were obvious. When the player's HP was low, they would have a chance of turning the tables.

The weakness was also obvious. Intelligence and MYS were too heavily reduced, and their Mental Resistance was too low. Not only would they not be able to reduce the damage, but they would also receive additional damage. Furthermore, many of the skills that were frozen were long-range abilities, so the Aberration's long-range combat ability was very weak. If they did not drag the opponent to the ground and engage in melee combat, they would be easily kited by the enemy.

Just as he was browsing through the combat information, Pork Bun and the others also saw the attributes shared by the Aberration players, and they were all extremely excited.

"Holy sh * t, this is too strong!"

"Although it's ugly to the core, I can do it!"

Everyone could not wait to activate their badges. Very soon, a network view appeared in the room, and they could see how Shazik and Lothaire interacted with the old members after joining the army.

Shazik was very normal. He had just joined the intelligence department a few days ago and was still familiarizing himself with the environment. He was getting along quite well with the department head, but he did not have a sense of presence. However, this was not a disadvantage. Lacking a sense of presence was the advantage of being an intelligence officer.

On the other hand, Lothaire was different. He was a loner and did not interact with any of the officers. If he was not training hard in the actual combat training room, he would be sharpening his blade alone in the room. He would also be staring at the wall in a daze. He was like a solitary autistic patient.

Han Xiao paused, thought about it, and headed to Lothaire's room.

When Lothaire had just joined, he had rushed to study the information of the Evolutionary Civilization and did not continue to communicate with him. Han Xiao decided to have a good talk with Lothaire now.

In terms of combat strength and potential, Lothaire could be ranked in the top five of the army, even surpassing Hardaway and only below Hella, Aurora, Fu Ding, and Nero. He was a top expert below Beyond Grade A. Han Xiao placed great importance on Lothaire's potential and felt that there was a need to care about his mental health.

After all, EsGod was the nightmare of Lothaire's previous life. Now that he had killed EsGod, he felt that he had to take responsibility. Lothaire was a stubborn and solitary person, so he might have lost his way at the crossroads of life.
